in_arabic.name: نضر
in_arabic.long_meaning: نضر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر النضري، ويعني النظر أو العطية أو الإنذار. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَنُضِّرَ مَنْ كَانَ يَأْمَنُ يَوْمَ الْفِتْنَةِ' (الانفطار: 15). ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية كدلالة على الإنذار أو التحذير من شيء ما.

in_hindi.name: नुज़्र
in_hindi.meaning: देखना या देना या चेतावनी देना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुज़्र नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'न-ज़-र' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है देखना, देना या चेतावनी देना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक प्रासंगिकता के कारण इसे चुना जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अक्सर सकारात्मक अर्थों से जुड़ा होता है, जैसे ज्ञानोदय या दिव्य मार्गदर्शन।

Historically, Nuzr has been used as a name for prophets and notable Islamic figures, symbolizing divine guidance or benevolence. The name carries connotations of enlightenment, vigilance, and generosity across Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nuzr holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic society, as it is associated with the concept of giving and generosity. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that giving to others selflessly is a form of worship and a means of seeking nearness to God. The name Nuzr, meaning something valuable and rare, reminds us of the importance of cherishing and sharing valuable resources and possessions with others. It is also a reminder of the importance of being grateful for the blessings we have received and sharing them with those in need (Sadaqah Jariyah).
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nuzr holds deep significance as it is a reminder of the preciousness and rarity of the blessings bestowed upon us by Allah (God). It is a call to recognize and appreciate the value of these blessings and to utilize them in the way that pleases Allah. The name Nuzr also serves as a reminder of the importance of generosity and selflessness in our daily lives, as we strive to embody the characteristics of a true servant of Allah. Ultimately, the name Nuzr is a reminder of the value of the spiritual journey and the importance of seeking nearness to Allah through acts of charity, kindness, and giving.
